title: Project Config
description: Per-project production limits and egress consent, loaded from projects/<slug>/project.yaml. Overrides the pipeline manifest's budget_default_usd / max_wall_time_minutes. The config is not self-attesting: its sha256 must be bound to an approval_policy decision_log entry written through the human-gate path; a run whose current digest has no matching approval is rejected. Loaded via schemas.artifacts.load_project_config_schema() / validate_project_config().

budget_usd_cap.description: Hard cap on paid calls for the run; a reservation that would exceed it fails preflight

default_video_endpoint.description: D4: the approved video model for every scene (e.g. bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video). A scene using another endpoint must carry model_override with a reason.

characters.description: Max canon characters the visual bible may build sheets for

provider_egress.description: Explicit one-time human consent that the listed content classes may leave the machine for this provider. visual_bible cannot start without it.
